Variants.Content: Entry The noble surname of Westeros signified both bloodline and recognized inheritance rights. Bastards of nobles who have not been legitimized usually use regional surnames: Snow in the North, Sand in Dorne, River in the Riverlands, Stony East in the Vale, Mountains in the West, and River in the West The regional surname is not a crime, but it will immediately let people know the circumstances of their birth. Some people regard it as a humiliation, while others regard it as an identity that does not need to be disguised; legalization of the royal family can change the legal status, but it cannot guarantee that it will change the memories of others.
